security_justification.audit_integrity: Preserves all required audit assertions, contract checks, and governance records without alteration.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Does not modify or interact with authentication or authorization mechanisms.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Derives public change metadata only; cryptographic signing and identity authority logic are untouched.
security_justification.concurrency: CI steps execute deterministically within their respective container and matrix environments.
security_justification.confidentiality: Untrusted pull requests receive no restricted secrets; token-gated jobs remain securely gated.
security_justification.cryptography: Does not introduce, modify, or rely upon cryptographic algorithms or keys.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Package discovery checker emits structured error diagnostics on standard streams without exposing credentials.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Operates within GitHub Actions runner environments with no external network security integrations.
security_justification.fail_posture: Package discovery and CI validations fail closed on mismatch, build errors, or test failures.
security_justification.lifecycle: Applies across the standard OpenSpec change lifecycle and CI PR/push verification workflows.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Changes are strictly confined to declared owned paths with no unintended file modifications.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Processes no user telemetry, personal data, or operational payloads.
security_justification.resource_retention: CI runner containers dispose of temporary files, packages, and outputs upon job completion.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Idempotent CI job execution with retry policies applied only to transient transport blips.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Preserves repository trust boundaries; fork PRs receive no write secrets or elevated permissions.
